audit.whatIsWrong: Quickdraw was tracked as a flat cooldown to wait out. Its real behaviour — 16/15/14/13/12s base, but 'hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost' — means it is almost never actually down while he is auto-attacking, which is why every window in this lane is 'right after he spends it', not 'when it is down'.
audit.why: Riot's E text states the auto-attack cooldown refund and the resistance refresh explicitly.
audit.corrected: The refund written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5], and the advice reframed to engaging immediately after he burns the dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet while this page's own whys already backed the packet — whys[0] calls Level 1 'a wash', whys[1] 'he out-trades you', whys[2] 'he pelts you back out', whys[3] 'keeping you on the back foot', whys[5] 'out-kites your Eclipse all-in', all against Kled or Skill rows.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Kled and the mirror audit says both charts were flipped to that as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves, ratings moved with them, and the two phases whys that contradicted the new sides rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated mechanics ran through the whole content layer: Smoke Screen was called a blind that 'turns off your autos', and Graves was given 'R + E true damage'. Neither exists. The full layer also wrote 'beartrap' instead of Bear Trap on a Rope.
audit.why: Riot's W text: the canister 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range' and slows on impact — no blind, so your autos and Violent Tendencies shots still land on a target you can see. Riot's R text is an explosive shell that hits the first champion then explodes in a cone; nothing in his kit carries the trueDamage flag. Riot's E grants Armor and Magic Resist, not damage.
audit.corrected: Blind replaced with the sight cut and slow in whys[4], spikes[1], spikes[2], mid, early and wants.foe[1]; the true-damage claim replaced with Collateral Damage's real 100s cone burst in whys[4], spikes[1] and wants.foe[2]; ability name fixed in the full layer.

edits.before: Graves concedes nothing at Level 1 the way a melee would — his burst shotgun autos chip Skaarl's mount health while you have no answer, so don't walk up for a trade you can't win. The moment your W (Violent Tendencies) and Q (Bear Trap) come online, you get a real window: land the Q slow, yank yourself in, and force the W on-hit shots before he can E-dash away. The problem is his E dash and smoke blind reset the kite every time, so if you whiff the Q he just pelts you and walks off with the trade.
edits.after: Graves concedes nothing at Level 1 the way a melee would — his burst shotgun autos chip Skaarl's mount health while you have no answer, so don't walk up for a trade you can't win. The moment your W (Violent Tendencies) and Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) come online you get a real window: land the Q slow, yank yourself in, and force the W on-hit shots before he can Quickdraw away. The problem is Quickdraw refunds off his autos, so if you whiff the Q he just pelts you and walks off with the trade.

edits.before: This is where Graves edges ahead. At 6 his R + E true-damage burst, layered with the W smoke blind that turns off your autos, can blow up dismounted-Skaarl Kled before you rebuild Courage to remount — that's his kill window, not yours. Don't dive him on cooldown; the smoke blind alone can blank your whole W shotgun rotation. Save your R to pin him against terrain instead of using it to chase, because a free-form chase just feeds his E-reset kite.
edits.after: This is where Graves edges ahead. At 6 his Collateral Damage (100s) cone burst, layered with a Smoke Screen that cuts your sight and slows you, can blow up dismounted Kled before you rebuild Courage to remount — that's his kill window, not yours. Don't dive him on cooldown; inside the smoke you cannot see the target your W shots need. Save your R to pin him against terrain instead of using it to chase, because a free-form chase just feeds his Quickdraw kite.

edits.before: Drop W smoke to blind your autos and W shots during your all-in window
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to cut your sight and slow you in your all-in window

edits.before: Hit his R + E true-damage burst on dismounted-Skaarl Kled before you can rebuild Courage
edits.after: Hit Collateral Damage's cone burst on dismounted Kled before you can rebuild Courage

notes: Two invented mechanics were live on this page and are the reason for most of the edits: Smoke Screen does not blind (Riot: it reduces sight range and slows on impact), and Graves has no true damage anywhere in his kit. Both claims would have made a paying user play the lane wrong in the direction of losing it. Graves' Q also carries a 'creates terrain' derived flag, which contradicts Riot's own Q text — the shell detonates on colliding with terrain, it does not create any; the flag is a tooltip-parse misfire and I did not write terrain creation anywhere. dosFull[2].t 'All-in with courage high' and several full-layer strings still say 'engage on Quickdraw's cooldown', which the refund makes misleading; they did not fit the length band.
